name: LavaRunners
summary:
Swing, climb, and leap your way through a tropical VR playground!

Welcome to LavaRunners, a vibrant virtual paradise where movement is everything. Inspired by the exhilarating locomotion of Gorilla Tag, this game throws you into a lush island world where your arms are your only way to move. No buttons. No joysticks. Just pure physicality.
